args.sql:
WITH market_risk_score AS (
    SELECT 
        mktregistry,
        (dlyflow / 1000.0) + 
        (esccomprate * 0.2) + 
        (interscore * 0.3) + 
        (vendcount * 0.1) - 
        (mktspan / 100.0) AS mrs
    FROM markets
)
SELECT 
    m.mktregistry,
    m.mktdenom,
    m.mktclass,
    m.mktspan,
    m.sizecluster,
    m.dlyflow,
    m.mthactive,
    m.vendcount,
    m.buycount,
    m.listtotal,
    m.interscore,
    m.esccomprate,
    m.market_status_reputation,
    mrs.mrs,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY mrs.mrs DESC) as mrs_rank
FROM 
    markets m
JOIN 
    market_risk_score mrs ON m.mktregistry = mrs.mktregistry
ORDER BY 
    mrs.mrs DESC;

events.sql:
WITH market_risk_score AS (
    SELECT 
        mktregistry,
        (dlyflow / 1000.0) + 
        (esccomprate * 0.2) + 
        (interscore * 0.3) + 
        (vendcount * 0.1) - 
        (mktspan / 100.0) AS mrs
    FROM markets
)
SELECT 
    m.mktregistry,
    m.mktdenom,
    m.mktclass,
    m.mktspan,
    m.sizecluster,
    m.dlyflow,
    m.mthactive,
    m.vendcount,
    m.buycount,
    m.listtotal,
    m.interscore,
    m.esccomprate,
    m.market_status_reputation,
    mrs.mrs,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY mrs.mrs DESC) as mrs_rank
FROM 
    markets m
JOIN 
    market_risk_score mrs ON m.mktregistry = mrs.mktregistry
ORDER BY 
    mrs.mrs DESC;
